result.summary: Found 1 notable visual issue: an element in the bottom navigation bar appears misaligned/overlapping, plus minor observations. Overall the page renders cleanly.

issues.description: A horizontal dark bar overlaps the search icon in the bottom navigation bar, obscuring it and making the tab look broken or disabled.
issues.suggestion: Inspect the bottom navigation bar for a misplaced overlay element (e.g., a drag handle, divider, or skeleton loader) and remove it or align it properly so the search icon is unobstructed.

issues.description: The second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza with -20% badge) has its image partially clipped at the bottom of the visible area with unusually tight spacing compared to the ramen card above.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent spacing/margins between list cards so adjacent content isn't visually crowding the card boundary.
